items.title: Pay operating cost balance (Nachzahlung)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie die Nachzahlung innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Zugang dieser Abrechnung.
items.computation: The payment period is 30 days starting from 'Zugang' (actual receipt) of this statement, not from a printed document date. The letter itself bears no issuance/document date anywhere in the text, so the start of the 30-day period cannot be fixed. Under §130 BGB a posted letter is typically deemed received a few days after dispatch, but without any reference date (no 'Datum', no postmark information) this cannot be computed exactly; normal German civil-law counting (§187 Abs.1 BGB: day of receipt not counted, period starts next day; §188 Abs.2: period ends 30 days later; §193 BGB: if that day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday, it moves to the next business day) could be applied once a receipt date is known, but no such date is available here. Due date left undetermined.

warnings: The letter has no printed document/issue date anywhere, so the 30-day payment deadline for the Nachzahlung, which runs from the date of receipt ('Zugang'), cannot be calculated exactly; the user should check the envelope postmark or email date to determine the actual receipt date and count 30 days from the day after that (adjusting for weekends/NW public holidays per §§187,188,193 BGB).
